title: Brand Social Media Designer
jobDescription: Noise Noise Art/Creative Brand & Social Media Designer Gurugram, Haryana Work Type: Full Time Apply Now About the Role Noise is looking for a Brand & Social Media Designer to join our team and help elevate our branded assets and content. This is a hands-on design role where you'll create engaging, on-brand visuals across social media, web, email, and digital ads, while leveraging AI-powered tools to speed up and enhance your creative workflow. What You'll Do Design engaging, brand-consistent creatives tailored for social media (Instagram, Tik Tok, Linked In, You Tube), websites, email marketing, and digital ads. Maintain and evolve visual identity guidelines across all digital campaigns and marketing initiatives. Collaborate closely with content and marketing teams to translate social media trends and campaign strategies into impactful designs. Develop illustrations, icons, layout templates, and other visual assets for daily content production. Use AI-powered design tools (Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Chat GPT, Gemini, Generative Fill) to brainstorm concepts, generate mockups, and accelerate production workflows. What We're Looking For 1–3 years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Visual Designer, or Digital Content Creator. Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. Solid understanding of social media platforms, including formats, dimensions, and optimal layouts for mobile viewing. Excellent understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, and visual storytelling. Working knowledge of AI-powered creative tools, with the ability to use them to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality. A bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field, with a strong portfolio showcasing branding and social media design work. A strong sense of aesthetics, attention to detail, and passion for internet culture and modern design trends. Bonus: basic motion graphics/video editing skills (After Effects, Premiere Pro, or Cap Cut) and experience building visual style guides or branding packages from scratch. title: Business Head
jobDescription: responsibilities. You’ll be in charge of defining strategy, scaling distribution, and ensuring Bose’s premium brand equity is preserved and amplified in the Indian market. Key Responsibilities 1) Strategic Leadership & Execution: Led the P&L management for online and marketplace channels, including revenue forecasting, cost optimization, and margin management. Develop annual operating plans and a 3-year strategic roadmap for the brand in India. Develop and execute the online and marketplace distribution strategy for Bose products, ensuring alignment with Noise’s overall business and growth objectives. Identify new growth opportunities within online and marketplace platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.), including market expansion, product launch strategies, and promotional campaigns. Set revenue targets, product mix strategy, and pricing frameworks in alignment with Bose HQ. 2) Marketplace P&L Management: Own the P&L for online channels (Bose on Noise’s website, marketplaces like Amazon, Flipkart, etc.), ensuring profitability and meeting key financial targets. Optimize pricing, product mix, and sales strategies to maximize profit margins and ROI. Monitor product inventory, pricing, and promotions on digital platforms to ensure sales objectives are met and stock levels are aligned with demand 3) Channel & Distribution Development Develop strong offline distribution muscle: premium CE retailers, large-format stores, and regional chains. Build D2C and e Com presence (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.) that aligns with Bose’s global playbook. 4) Brand Building & CX Partner with Bose global and local brand teams to localize brand messaging and uphold premium positioning. Establish a robust CX and after-sales network to match Bose’s global standards. 5) Cross-Functional Leadership Hire and lead a cross-functional team across sales, trade marketing, distribution, service, and channel ops. Collaborate with Noise’s internal teams (finance, logistics, legal, customer support) to build back-end scale. 6) Competitive Intelligence & Market Insights: Stay up-to-date with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in online commerce and marketplaces. Conduct regular competitive analysis to understand industry shifts, best practices, and opportunities to outmaneuver competitors in the digital space. The Ideal Noisemaker: 10–12 years of experience in consumer electronics, lifestyle brands, or premium tech/hardware. Strong experience in managing P&L for online and marketplace sales, with the ability to optimize sales, margins, and cost structures. Strong brand-building mindset with an understanding of premium customer experience. Leadership exposure in fast-growing, entrepreneurial environments or brand-licensed operations is preferred. Excellent stakeholder management—internal (founders, board) and external (Bose HQ, partners). MBA from a Tier 1 institute is preferred but not mandatory. title: Ui Ux Designer 7 Yrs Exp Design Education
jobDescription:
Job Description: Founded in 2014 by Amit Khatri and Gaurav Khatri, Noise was born with a bold mission—to democratize connected lifestyle technology for every Indian. With an unwavering focus on consumer-first innovation, this homegrown brand has consistently pushed boundaries, introducing industry-defining breakthroughs across wearable tech, audio, and connected devices. Today, with a vibrant community of over 40 million users, Noise is India’s #1 smartwatch brand and the #2 brand in Truly Wireless Audio—a testament to its relentless pursuit of excellence. In a landmark moment, Noise recently welcomed global audio giant Bose as a strategic investor, marking a bold step forward in its mission to redefine the future of audio and connected tech on a global scale. Noi About the

ROLE:
As a UI/UX Designer you will collaborate with product management and engineering to define and implement innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals, and experience. You’ll have the chance to make an impact across all end users of the web and mobile applications. Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead user interface design for mobile applications at Noise. Quickly visualize and prototype design concepts through mood boards, hi-fidelity mockups, visual comps, and animations, effectively communicating design ideas and direction. Develop cohesive, elegant visual design systems and UI patterns, from conceptualization through final execution. Champion Noise’s visual identity ensuring consistency and quality across all platforms and touchpoints. Clearly articulate visual design challenges and craft effective, user-centric solutions aligned with business goals. Efficiently iterate on designs based on feedback to deliver high-quality, visually compelling outcomes within tight timelines. Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Marketing to ensure seamless implementation. Manage and prioritize multiple visual design projects simultaneously, consistently balancing quality and deadlines. Requirements : 7+ years designing high-impact consumer web and mobile application design. A formal education in Design from a reputed university. A drive for excellence; an enthusiasm to constantly push the boundaries of the visual and user experience we create. Exceptional skills in UI design, complemented by solid UX fundamentals. Strong proficiency in rapid prototyping and visualization tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite). In-depth knowledge of modern UI trends and best practices. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly present design ideas and rationale. Ability to efficiently integrate constructive feedback into final designs. Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines c oncurrently. Strong fundamental knowledge of design principles, user behavior and design trends. Clear, concise verbal and written communication skills. Strong presentation and influencing skills. A strong balance between idealism and pragmatism in thought and action Being a thought leader when it comes to user experience and design in general An online portfolio of professional work is required. Why Join Us: Lead critical operations that directly impact business expansion and profitability. Work in a dynamic, tech-driven environment with a data-first approach to fulfillment. title: Director Human Resource
jobDescription:
Noise Noise Human Resources Director
- Human Resource Gurugram, Haryana Work Type: Full Time Apply Now Why this role exists We are not looking for someone to run HR. We are looking for someone to build the people system that builds the company. This is a founder-partner role. You will work directly with the founders on questions that actually matter: ● Who we hire ● How we operate ● What kind of company we become If your instinct is to follow playbooks, this won’t work. If your instinct is to write one, read on. What success looks like Not headcount. Not engagement scores. Revenue per employee. We scale through talent density, better systems, and AI leverage
- not by adding bodies. What will you own ●Culture & Operating System: Translate founder intent into how the company actually behaves. Build a culture of ownership, speed, and craft
- and protect it as we scale. ●Talent Density: Raise the hiring bar. Every hire should improve the average. Build a global talent lens
- the best people won’t all sit in Gurugram ●AI-Native HR: Rebuild HR from first principles with AI at the core
- not as an add-on. Drive productivity programs that make every employee materially better. ●Performance & Rewards: Create a system that is honest, fast, and differentiated. Reward outcomes, not tenure. Push the middle. Pull the top. ●Leadership & Capability: Build internal leaders, not dependency on external hiring. Design real development
- not training theatre. ●Employee Experience: Treat every touchpoint like a product. From hiring to exit
- intentional, sharp, and worth recommending. Who you are ● A builder, not an operator of inherited systems ● AI-native in how you think and work ● A first-principles thinker, not benchmark-driven ● Someone who has personally shaped culture, not just maintained it ● A magnet for strong talent
- people want to work with you again ● Equally comfortable with strategy and detail ● Direct, low-ego, high-agency Pedigree is optional. What you’ve built isn’t. What won’t work ● Playbook HR ● Incremental thinking ● Comfort with average performance ● Treating culture as events, not behaviour Why this is a career-defining role You don’t often get to build the people engine of a company at this stage
- with founder access, real mandate, and global ambition. This is one of those times. The Ideal "Noisemaker" :
- Full-time MBA in Human Resources from a premier institute
- 10 to 15 years of post-MBA experience with substantial exposure to a fast-paced start-up/ new-age organization
- A very strong focus on people development and culture building
- You need to be a people person with strong leadership abilities
- Should be comfortable working in a rapidly growing and ever-evolving organization.
- Should have led the creation & implementation of HR strategy (Employee engagement, performance, manpower, rewards & L&D)
- Demonstrated innovation around key HR programs (Engagement, Rewards, Performance) to meet business needs
- An excellent communicator, you will need to ensure that the chaos of growth is managed well and people's productivity is effectively channelized to meet the company's goals. title: Ad Director Product Nfa
jobDescription:
Noise Noise Product Management AD/Director
- Product NFA Gurugram, Haryana Work Type: Full Time Apply Now About Noise Founded in 2014 by Amit Khatri and Gaurav Khatri, Noise began with a mission to democratize connected technology for every Indian. Today, Noise is India's #1 smartwatch brand with more than 40 million users , an expanding ecosystem of smart wearables, and Bose as a strategic investor. We're building products that millions rely on every day and we're looking for people who want to define what the next generation of connected consumer technology looks like. The mission India is the world's most interesting health-tech market right now. Your job is to build the app that meets people where they are and nudges them, delightfully, toward where they could be. Not a feature list. Not a dashboard. A companion. One they come back to tomorrow. The problems worth solving This is what makes the role genuinely hard and genuinely interesting. The cold-start problem for health data Habit formation in a low-trust environment Making health data mean something India-specific health context Delight as a retention mechanic, not a cosmetic What you'll own You'll lead product for the entire Noise Fit app not a slice of it. That means: Core Experience End-to-end app experience across health, fitness, wellness, engagement and connected-device features. Activation and onboarding the first seven days that determine whether a user stays. Daily habit loops—the features and nudges that bring someone back every morning. Health intelligence layer—turning raw sensor data into insights users can actually act upon. AI/ML-driven personalization through contextual coaching, adaptive goals and smarter recommendations. Growth & Business Retention architecture including streaks, challenges, community and reward systems. Monetization opportunities including subscriptions, premium experiences and ecosystem partnerships. Experimentation culture through A/B testing, funnel analysis and rapid iteration. Device-to-app experience connecting what happens on the wrist with what happens on the phone. Cross-functional leadership across Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing and Hardware teams. Who we're looking for We're looking for someone with 8+ years of consumer product management experience and a proven record of building and scaling B2C mobile products. More importantly, we're looking for someone who: Thinks about user emotion as much as user flow. Is deeply comfortable with product analytics using tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase or similar. Ships fast, experiments constantly and makes decisions backed by data. Has exceptional product taste and strong design instincts. Can move seamlessly between product vision and execution. Is genuinely curious about Indian consumers and how they build long-term habits. Wants to solve difficult consumer problems at massive scale. Why this role, why now The scale is immediate : Your first feature reaches tens of millions of users. There is no "build the audience first" phase. The category is still being written: Health-tech in India is still in its early innings. You'll help define what the category becomes. Hardware meets software: With Bose as a strategic investor and a world-class hardware team, you'll build products at the intersection of wearables, AI, health intelligence and consumer technology. Real ownership: You'll define strategy, execute it and see the impact quickly. High trust. High accountability. Fast decisions. A team that ships: Noise has grown from a startup into India's leading wearable brand by moving quickly and staying obsessed with product quality. title: Product Manager Growth
jobDescription:
Noise Noise Product Management Product Manager
- Growth Gurugram, Haryana Work Type: Full Time Apply Now About Noise Founded in 2014 by Amit Khatri and Gaurav Khatri, Noise began with a mission to democratize connected technology for every Indian. Today, Noise is India's #1 smartwatch brand with more than 40 million users , an expanding ecosystem of smart wearables, and Bose as a strategic investor. We're building products that millions rely on every day and we're looking for people who want to define what the next generation of connected consumer technology looks like. The mission India is the world's most interesting health-tech market right now. Your job is to turn that scale into revenue — to build the monetisation engine that lets millions of free users become paying users, without breaking the trust that got them here. Not a discount machine. Not a paywall bolted on at the end. A growth engine. One that earns the upgrade. The problems worth solving This is what makes the role genuinely hard and genuinely interesting. Converting a free, habit-forming product into sustainable revenue Pricing and packaging for a price-sensitive, UPI-first market Designing paywalls that convert without eroding trust or engagement Finding the monetisable moment inside a health and fitness journey Building an experimentation engine that turns hunches into evidence What you'll own You'll own monetisation for the entire Noise Fit app — the full journey from first open to first payment, and every renewal after. Monetisation product Subscription funnel — paywall design, pricing experiments, trial mechanics, renewal optimisation In-app purchase revenue — store watch faces, content packs, and new categories Free-to-paid conversion journey end-to-end — first open to first payment New monetisation opportunities — partnerships, health commerce, premium features Experimentation & analytics A/B testing roadmap for all monetisation surfaces — paywalls, pricing, placement, copy Monetisation metrics — ARPU, conversion rate, LTV, subscription churn, revenue per cohort Funnel instrumentation with Data; dashboard ownership; actionable insight pipeline Hypothesis backlog — every test has a defined expected outcome and success threshold Who we're looking for We're looking for someone with 2-4 years in PM with monetisation, growth, or revenue-adjacent experience. More importantly, we're looking for someone who: Has run A/B tests end-to-end — knows what valid looks like, and what to do when results are inconclusive Has touched a paywall, subscription flow, or IAP mechanic — and has a POV on why it worked or didn't Is fluent in Amplitude, Mixpanel, Clever Tap, Firebase; SQL a bonus Understands ARPU and retention are coupled — won't grow revenue by quietly killing engagement Is curious about Indian consumer behaviour — price sensitivity, UPI psychology, what closes the loop in Jaipur or Patna Why this role, why now Ownership from day one: You're laying the foundations, not optimising the margins. The decisions you make in the first six months shape the revenue architecture for years. Scale that gives you power: 40 million users means experiments reach statistical significance in days. A 1% conversion lift is a real business outcome you'll see clearly. The India opportunity: Consumer monetisation in India is still being figured out. Western playbooks don't transfer cleanly. If you crack it here, you've built something that didn't exist before. Real learning velocity: Direct access to senior PMs, a strong data team, and an engineering culture built for experimentation. title: Technical Product Manager R D Wearables
jobDescription: requirements and development plans. Evaluate new technologies, components, and partnerships to enhance product capabilities. Technical Product Development Own end-to-end technical requirements for wearable features and platform capabilities. Create detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), technical specifications, and validation plans. Drive development of health and fitness features, including: Heart Rate Monitoring Sleep Tracking Stress Monitoring Sp O₂ Monitoring Activity Recognition Energy & Recovery Metrics AI-powered Health Insights Collaborate with firmware, hardware, mobile app, cloud, and algorithm teams to ensure seamless implementation. R&D Execution Lead feasibility studies, proofs-of-concept, and technology evaluations. Drive sensor selection, optical architecture discussions, algorithm integration, and system optimization. Work with engineering teams to resolve technical bottlenecks and product trade-offs. Ensure technical readiness before product commercialization. Partner & Vendor Management Collaborate with chipset vendors, sensor suppliers, algorithm providers, and ODM/OEM partners. Manage technical discussions, integration plans, timelines, and deliverables. Evaluate third-party technology solutions and drive technical negotiations. Validation & Performance Define KPIs and success metrics for wearable performance. Analyze validation data and benchmark performance against industry-leading products. Drive improvements in: Accuracy, Battery Life, Sensor Performance, User Experience, System Reliability Support certification, field testing, and production readiness activities. The Ideal Noisemaker: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields. 5–8 years of experience in Product Management, R&D, Systems Engineering, or Technical Program Management. Experience working on consumer electronics, wearables, Io T devices, health-tech products, or embedded systems. Strong understanding of: Embedded Systems Firmware Development Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Sensors and Signal Processing Mobile App Integration Cloud Architecture AI/ML-based Consumer Features Ability to understand technical architecture and translate it into customer-focused product requirements. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with smartwatch, smart ring, fitness tracker, or hearable products. Understanding of PPG sensors, IMU sensors, optical systems, and health algorithms. Experience working with algorithm validation, calibration, and performance benchmarking. Familiarity with RTOS-based embedded platforms and wearable chipset ecosystems. Exposure to health and wellness domains, including biometric sensing and digital health solutions. Experience working with global technology vendors and manufacturing partners. Why Join Noise? Build products used by millions of consumers. Work on cutting-edge wearable technologies and health innovations. Collaborate with top engineering, algorithm, and design talent. Influence product strategy from concept to commercialization. Be part of one of India's fastest-growing smart wearable brands.
